mutation_control.detail: Inversion 4 is what distinguishes 'a check exists' from 'the right check exists'; it catches the common regression where a gate is simplified to a truthiness test and silently opens on "false". Inversion 3 is caught by the structural assertion and NOT by the behavioural absence-of-request assertion — with the short-circuit gone, authentication still refuses first and no request is issued for that other reason. That is stated explicitly so the bundle is not read as claiming the behavioural test alone is guard-sensitive.

runtime_proof.harness: The change is confined to apps/command-center's data layer. It opens no database connection, runs no migration, changes no schema and alters no repository call; its entire runtime effect is on outbound HTTPS requests to https://api.supabase.com/. getStorageHealth is a privileged boundary whose first statement is `await assertPrivilegedRequestAuthenticated()`, which resolves the current Next request through headers() and fails closed outside a request scope, so a unit test cannot drive its body end to end. next/headers cannot be module-mocked here either: node:test's mock.module requires --experimental-test-module-mocks, which this runner does not set — measured, not assumed ('import_node_test.mock.module is not a function'). Rather than add an unauthenticated export purely to make the boundary testable — a real security regression bought for a convenience — the property is established behaviourally on a globalThis.fetch recorder and structurally per chokepoint, in the idiom privileged-boundary-guard.test.ts already uses. No live-database observation is offered and none is claimed.

queries.name: a shut gate issues zero management-plane requests
queries.method: delete UNIT_TALK_COMMAND_CENTER_MANAGEMENT_API_ENABLED, replace globalThis.fetch with a recorder, call getStorageHealth() in-process under the real Node runtime, then filter the recorded calls to those whose URL starts with https://api.supabase.com/
queries.significance: This is the acceptance criterion asserted on the absence of the request rather than on rendered output. The call itself fails closed on authentication outside a request scope, so this proves the stronger property that nothing leaks even on the failing path.

queries.name: the same holds for every non-"true" value, not only for an absent one
queries.method: repeat the above for 'false', '1', 'yes' and the empty string
queries.result: zero recorded management-plane calls in every case
queries.significance: A gate keyed on truthiness rather than on the exact string would open on 'false'. This is the behavioural half of what mutation 4 proves structurally.

queries.name: each of the three functions that can reach the management plane owns its own refusal
queries.method: parse the body of getStorageHealth, fetchManagementJson and runManagementQuery out of the source and assert the position of each check
queries.result: getStorageHealth: `assertPrivilegedRequestAuthenticated` precedes `isManagementPlaneEnabled`, which precedes `await Promise.all`. fetchManagementJson and runManagementQuery: `assertManagementPlaneEnabled()` precedes both `fetch(` and `resolveManagementEnv`.
queries.significance: One shared chokepoint would be a single point of failure for a later refactor. Requiring the check before resolveManagementEnv is what makes a shut gate report a policy refusal rather than a missing credential.

queries.name: degradation is honest rather than absent
queries.method: call unavailableStorageHealth('because the gate is shut') and inspect every status-bearing field
queries.result: managementPlane.available === false with the given reason; storageDomains contains both 'app' and 'ingestion'; disk.alertStatus === 'unavailable' and every storageDomains[].alertStatus === 'unavailable'
queries.significance: An omitted row renders as nothing and nothing reads as healthy, which is why 'unavailable' is a member of the StorageAlertStatus union rather than an absent field.

queries.method: git show <ref>:apps/command-center/src/lib/data/storage-health.ts | grep -c assertPrivilegedRequestAuthenticated, for origin/main, for this lane's #1494-verbatim commit 6cde3622f, and for the head
